```{r}
required_packages <- c("DBI", "duckdb", "dplyr", "here", "htmltools", "jsonlite", "scales")
missing_packages <- required_packages[!vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Install the required R packages before rendering: ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(dplyr))
source(here::here("r_scripts", "lib", "utils", "repo_env.R"))
source(here::here("r_scripts", "lib", "utils", "datalake_root.r"))
source(here::here("r_scripts", "lib", "duckdb", "db_connect.R"))
source(here::here("r_scripts", "lib", "import_data", "viewer_activity.R"))
source(here::here("r_scripts", "lib", "plots", "domains", "audience", "viewer_activity.R"))

normalize_parameter <- function(value) {
  if (is.null(value) || length(value) == 0L || is.na(value[[1]])) return(NULL)
  value <- trimws(as.character(value[[1]]))
  if (nzchar(value)) value else NULL
}

positive_integer <- function(value, default, minimum = 1L) {
  value <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(value))
  if (is.na(value) || value < minimum) default else value
}

summary_metric <- function(value, label) {
  htmltools::div(
    class = "community-summary__metric",
    htmltools::tags$dt(label),
    htmltools::tags$dd(scales::comma(value))
  )
}

talent_code <- normalize_parameter(params$talent_code)
video_id <- normalize_parameter(params$video_id)
minimum_messages <- positive_integer(params$minimum_messages, 1L)
overlap_max_videos <- positive_integer(params$overlap_max_videos, 16L, minimum = 2L)
overlap_max_selected <- positive_integer(params$overlap_max_selected, 30L)
sankey_max_videos <- positive_integer(params$sankey_max_videos, 12L)
sankey_max_selected <- positive_integer(params$sankey_max_selected, 20L)
sankey_max_users <- positive_integer(params$sankey_max_users, 30L)
heatmap_max_videos <- positive_integer(params$heatmap_max_videos, 24L)
heatmap_max_selected <- positive_integer(params$heatmap_max_selected, 40L)
heatmap_max_users <- positive_integer(params$heatmap_max_users, 80L)

load_repo_env(repo_root = here::here())
db_path <- talent_lakehouse_db_path()
if (!file.exists(db_path)) {
  stop("Unified talent lakehouse not found: ", db_path, call. = FALSE)
}
con <- duckdb_connect(db_path = db_path, read_only = TRUE)

viewer_video_activity <- load_viewer_video_activity(con, talent_code) %>%
  filter(.data$message_count >= minimum_messages)
if (nrow(viewer_video_activity) == 0L) {
  stop("No collected chat activity matched the selected scope.", call. = FALSE)
}
available_live_videos <- load_available_live_videos(con, talent_code)
classification_contributions <- load_title_classification_contributions(con, talent_code)
video_explorer_data <- viewer_activity_video_explorer_prep(
  viewer_video_activity,
  video_catalog = available_live_videos,
  classification_contributions = classification_contributions
)

community_shape <- viewer_activity_community_shape_prep(
  viewer_video_activity,
  max_overlap_videos = overlap_max_videos
)

talent_label <- viewer_video_activity %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$talent_name), nzchar(.data$talent_name)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$talent_name) %>%
  dplyr::pull(.data$talent_name)
talent_label <- if (length(talent_label) > 0L) {
  paste(talent_label, collapse = ", ")
} else if (!is.null(talent_code)) {
  talent_code
} else {
  "All talent communities"
}
```

```{r}
#| classes: summary-output
scope_dates <- as.Date(viewer_video_activity$stream_at)
scope_dates <- scope_dates[!is.na(scope_dates)]
period_label <- if (length(scope_dates)) {
  paste(format(range(scope_dates), "%b %Y"), collapse = " – ")
} else {
  "Period unavailable"
}

htmltools::tags$header(
  id = "overview",
  class = "community-summary dashboard-section",
  htmltools::div(
    class = "community-summary__identity",
    htmltools::span(class = "community-summary__eyebrow", "Talent"),
    htmltools::h1(gsub("_", " ", talent_label, fixed = TRUE)),
    htmltools::span(class = "community-summary__period", period_label)
  ),
  htmltools::tags$dl(
    class = "community-summary__metrics",
    summary_metric(sum(viewer_video_activity$message_count), "Total messages"),
    summary_metric(nrow(community_shape$profiles), "Community chatters"),
    summary_metric(nrow(available_live_videos), "Available live streams"),
    summary_metric(
      dplyr::n_distinct(viewer_video_activity$video_id),
      "Streams with chat activity"
    )
  )
)
```

### Community layers

See how occasional, returning, regular, and core participants shape conversation.

:::

`Audience`{.dashboard-card__badge}

:::

::: {.dashboard-card__body}

```{r}
viewer_activity_community_shape_d3(
  community_shape,
  view = "segments",
  height = 250
)
```

:::

<details>
<summary>Layer definitions</summary>
<p>
Drop-in: one stream. Returning: two or three streams. Regular: four to seven
streams. Core: eight or more streams. Bar length is the number of chatters;
the annotation shows the share of conversation produced.
</p>
</details>

:::

::: {.dashboard-card}

::: {.dashboard-card__header}

::: {}

## Chatter flows

Follow individual chatters through streams and into title topics or tags.

:::

`Relationship view`{.dashboard-card__badge}

:::

::: {.dashboard-card__body}

```{r}
viewer_activity_video_explorer_d3(
  video_explorer_data,
  view = "sankey",
  initial_video_count = sankey_max_videos,
  initial_video_ids = video_id,
  max_selected = sankey_max_selected,
  max_users = sankey_max_users,
  height = 620
)
```

:::

<details>
<summary>About this view</summary>
<p>
Each path follows an observed chatter into a stream and then into the topic or
normalized title tag attached to that stream. Use the Streams and Chatters
selectors to search the complete catalogs; filtering options never silently
changes the chart. Path width uses the selected engagement measure. When a
stream has several normalized tags, its outgoing flow is divided evenly so
engagement is not duplicated. View contribution uses the latest canonical
video performance and is not recalculated when streams are filtered.
</p>
</details>

:::

::: {#participation .dashboard-card .dashboard-section}

::: {.dashboard-card__header}

::: {}

## Chatter–stream participation

Compare attendance patterns and identify chatters who move through similar streams.

:::

`Heatmap`{.dashboard-card__badge}

:::

::: {.dashboard-card__body}

```{r}
viewer_activity_video_explorer_d3(
  video_explorer_data,
  view = "heatmap",
  initial_video_count = heatmap_max_videos,
  initial_video_ids = video_id,
  max_selected = heatmap_max_selected,
  max_users = heatmap_max_users,
  height = 660,
  compact = TRUE
)
```

:::

<details>
<summary>About this view</summary>
<p>
Rows place people with similar stream-attendance patterns near one another. A
shared vertical pattern means two chatters participated in many of the same
selected streams. Switch the cell measure between attendance and messages, or
restore a simple highest-activity row order.
</p>
</details>

:::

::: {#audience-overlap .dashboard-card .dashboard-section}

::: {.dashboard-card__header}

::: {}

## Stream audience overlap

Compare shared chatter audiences across streams with Jaccard similarity.

:::

`Network matrix`{.dashboard-card__badge}

:::

::: {.dashboard-card__body}

```{r}
viewer_activity_video_explorer_d3(
  video_explorer_data,
  view = "overlap",
  initial_video_count = overlap_max_videos,
  initial_video_ids = video_id,
  max_selected = overlap_max_selected,
  height = 620
)
```

:::

<details>
<summary>About this view</summary>
<p>
Darker purple indicates that two streams share a larger proportion of their
combined chatter audience. Hover for the shared-chatter count and exact
similarity. Use Compare to choose any videos in the current scope; the matrix
recalculates immediately for that subset. The diagonal is gray because each
stream is being compared with itself.
</p>
</details>

:::
